summary: Austrian family firm, 45 staff, 5-10 M EUR; our ~EUR 144k is only ~1.4-2.9 % of its turnover and it is reviewing small accounts. Sole source of the duplex pump shaft HI (105.87, no second source), flawless quality (0 ppm, OTD 92 %). Owner expects partnership for holding prices in 2022 but offered an open-book walk-through. Open moderately, take up the open book, offer volume and acknowledge the 2022 favour; do not risk a walk.
notes: Says it is reviewing small accounts and will focus on customers with volume; expects partnership for the 2022 favour. We pay 4.4 days late on average (36 % >5 days late) without written complaint. No should-cost and no quality lever.

arguments: index change, only drivers that fell

tactics: Thank it for holding prices in 2022, then ask to go through its calculation.
Argue from its hourly rate and material share, not from our target.
Offer a binding 12-month volume to show we are a volume customer.
Accept a moderate gain; do not push it to a walk on a sole-source part.
playbook.expected_concession: Renewals settled 2-4 pts below its ask (asked +2.6 % settled -1.0 % in 2025); expect a few percent, slowly.
